lines: Ibrahim was now an old man. And his wife, Sarah, had never had a child.
One day, guests arrived at his tent. Strangers, whom no one knew. They said: peace. He said: peace.
Ibrahim was known for his generosity. Without a word, he went to his family, and came back with a fat roasted calf.
He placed it near them and said: "Will you not eat?" But their hands did not reach for it. And he felt afraid of them.
They said: do not fear. We are messengers, sent to the people of Lut. And they gave him good news.
His wife, who was standing nearby, smiled. And they gave her the good news of a son, Ishaq, and after Ishaq, Yaqub.

She said: shall I give birth, when I am an old woman, and my husband is an old man? This is an amazing thing! They said: "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house."
From Ismail would come the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam. From Ishaq would come Yaqub, Yusuf, Musa, Dawud, Sulaiman and Isa. The father of the prophets.
